answer: Escrowed Identity Ledger: each agent posts a refundable escrow sized to the median lifetime value its role earns, held against verified grievances. A clone starts at zero reputation, so it earns only low-value work while its escrow stays locked; any fraud forfeits the full balance to victims. Honest agents recover escrow at exit, making the marginal clone a guaranteed loss. The trellis of reputation links cannot be copied. Escrow sits in a harbor account, and forfeiture rules anchor the timber of trust.
